content_units: Family Game Night Fit

Here are 6 strong picks for a mixed-age gathering that meet your priorities:   4–7 players  ,   teach in under 10 minutes  ,   finish within 60 minutes  , and   low reliance on trivia or drawing skill  . I included   one cooperative game  ,   one word-based game  , and   one especially good fit when one player is very competitive  .
Best Board Games for Ages 9 to 68
Game   Players   Time   Why it fits   Best for
Just One   4–7   20–30 min   Cooperative word guessing; easy to teach; very inclusive     Cooperative option
Codenames   4–8+   15–30 min   Team word game with simple rules and broad age appeal     Word-based option
Ticket to Ride   2–5   30–60 min   Light strategy, clear goals, satisfying competition     Competitive player pick
Sushi Go Party!   2–8   20–40 min   Fast drafting, cute theme, easy turns, scales well   Mixed ages and casual groups
6 nimmt!   2–10   30–45 min   Simultaneous play keeps everyone engaged; simple but clever   Larger family tables
Camel Up   3–8   30–45 min   Silly racing/betting game; exciting without being harsh   Lively family energy

Best Match by Family Style
-   Most universally safe pick:     Just One
-   Best if your family likes words:     Codenames
-   Best if one person really wants to win:     Ticket to Ride
-   Best for laughter and low rules overhead:     Camel Up
-   Best for 6–7 players with little downtime:     6 nimmt!
-   Best if you want something cute and quick:     Sushi Go Party!

Game Night Notes
For your age spread, the safest starting order is:
-   Start:   Just One or Camel Up
-   Second game:   Sushi Go Party! or 6 nimmt!
-   Closer for the competitive crowd:   Ticket to Ride

One context note:   Ticket to Ride   officially tops out at   5 players   in the base game, so it fits your requested range only if your actual table is   4 or 5  . If you expect   6 or 7 for sure  , the strongest swap-in is   For Sale   or   Wits & Wagers Family  —though the latter leans a bit more on knowledge/trivia than your request suggests.
